final: WITH all_records AS (SELECT crewref, CASE WHEN spanmin > 0 THEN gbsize / spanmin ELSE NULL END as gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL), operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) as scan_count, AVG(gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min FROM all_records GROUP BY crewref), global_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) as global_avg FROM all_records), above_avg_operators AS (SELECT os.scan_count, os.avg_gb_per_min, g.global_avg FROM operator_stats os CROSS JOIN global_avg_val g WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > g.global_avg) SELECT AVG(scan_count) as avg_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) - (SELECT global_avg FROM global_avg_val) as excess FROM above_avg_operators
